firstPlayerRule: Whoever last used a pen takes the first turn.
houseFallback: If there is a tie or this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Give that player the First Player Token and continue clockwise.
In the Cooperative Anthology variant, each human player takes a normal turn, followed by Penny Dreadful's turn.
